estimator_change: largest containing SAM proposal instead of smallest; unchanged residual-first temporal decomposition
hypothesis: small nested masks make regional affine protection unidentifiable and retain texture jitter; broader structural support may separate nonaffine jitter without losing coherent motion
projection: same instantaneous regional affine / per-point mean constraints on the new larger partition; no claim to preserve each original small part
score_head: unchanged full-grid top5-percent continuous intensity and frozen I/(I+tau)
counterfactual: unchanged 32 official DEV MP4s, 8px, two seeds, all 128 inputs
natural_control: all 63 separately scored natural DEV originals; quantify every decline, not only the mean; existing 95-original human-pair overlap is auxiliary and not sufficient validation
primary_statistic: 32 equal-weight sources; average CF seeds per source; signed mean(CF)-mean(base)
acceptance: joint jitter invariance and genuine motion response; a lower CF mean alone does not pass
limitations: posthoc development hypothesis, reference-frame masks may merge independently moving parts, same tracker may still miss physical train motion
